rationale.consistency: Properly follows Caddy module conventions, struct tags, interfaces, and unmarshaling patterns used by other filters.
rationale.edge_cases: Gracefully handles quoted values, missing semicolons, missing equal signs, and unparseable lines.
rationale.scope: Strictly implements the required set_cookie log field filter without any unrelated changes.
rationale.readability: The parseSetCookieNameValue helper is cleanly extracted and well-commented, keeping the main loop easy to read.
rationale.robustness: Uses safe slice pre-allocation, robust substring indexing, and ignores fields of the wrong type without panicking.
rationale.maintainability: Decoupled parsing and action application make it straightforward to add new actions in the future.
